2317-5231-7084-8345.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-4544-8095--106.easyPrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4544-8095--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4544-8095--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

1545-1981-2292-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2292-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2097-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2097-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Jolene
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

553-4586-6555.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1558-3875-4231-5621-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-5621-7824.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-3209-4772.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{G}, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {3} and tapping two creature tokens, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two tapped creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.
2034-3209-4772.notes: The starting cost can be reduced by tapping creatures to pay for Sprout Swarm using its convoke ability, and/or sacrificing those creatures to Ashnod's Altar.

2092-2757-5073-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Tinder Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Tinder Wall, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2113-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2113-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

539-1912-4552-7251.description:
Activate Vindictive Warden by paying {0} due to Biomancer's Familiar and Blossoming Tortoise (as Vindictive Warden is a land due to Ashaya), dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1409-1780-6441.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-4446-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2034-4446-5170-6132.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-1879-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

4067-5672-7066.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

331-3011-4090.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
331-3011-4090.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
331-3011-4090.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

2350-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

586-5258-5618-6580-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6283-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6283-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Dazzling Angel indestructible.
3490-4050-6283-6719.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1305-1437-6619.description:
Cast Summon: Knights of Round by paying {6}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying Summon: Knights of Round three times.
Resolve a copy of the Summon: Knights of Round spell, choosing to have it enter with five lore counters on it due to its read-ahead ability.
The Summon: Knights of Round token's fifth chapter ability triggers, causing creatures you control to get +2/+2 until end of turn and putting an indestructible counter on each of them, and then causing you to sacrifice the Summon: Knights of Round token.
Repeat from step 2.
1305-1437-6619.notes: With the extra two copies of the Summon: Knight of Round spell, you can have them enter and create infinite creature tokens.

224-1772-2653-5233.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1692-2981-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-2981-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-2981-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1295-2177-5962.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland cards in your library.
Cast Demonlord Belzenlok by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Demonlord Belzenlok enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the remainder of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

224-2366-3346-4452-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
"Mercenary" chosen with Rukarumel.
224-2366-3346-4452-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Bog Glider.
Repeat.

2459-3156-3558-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
2459-3156-3558-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Rograkh.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

678-1872-3771.manaNeeded: {1} if Animar does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
678-1872-3771.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying at most {6}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

3492-3609-3942.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-3942.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Coretapper from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.
